channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Anand Mahindra shares viral video of ‘aapda autorickshaw’ in London street; netizens celebrate ‘reverse colonisation’
item.description: The sight of the quintessential Indian three-wheeler navigating British roads has sparked a wave of amused and prideful reactions across social media, with many users celebrating the ‘reverse colonisation’.

item.title: Gyanesh Kumar salary, perks and assets: Does CEC have to disclose net worth like MPs, MLAs? Explained
item.description: The CEC of India draws a basic monthly salary of ₹2,50,000, equivalent to that of a judge or a Cabinet Secretary. Previously, it was equivalent to the salary of a Supreme Court Judge.

item.title: Jaishankar says UN ‘largely irrelevant’, UNSC ‘gridlocked’: Why India pushes for reform | Explained
item.description: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar has called the UN “largely irrelevant” to major global crises, blaming a “gridlocked” Security Council. His remarks come as India pushes for UNSC reform, greater representation for the Global South and Africa, and a permanent seat for India.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan activate Makkah pact amid Houthi attacks: Is this NATO of the Middle East?
item.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have activated the Makkah defence pact amid renewed Houthi attacks. Touted as a “Muslim NATO”, the pact faces questions over whether its members share enough strategic interests for a NATO-style collective response.

item.title: From IBM's Arvind Krishna to MetLife's Michael A Khalaf: Here's a list of executives Piyush Goyal met in the US
item.description: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met executives from IBM, AIA Group, General Atlantic, MetLife, Estée Lauder and Blackstone during his US visit, pitching India as an investment destination amid ongoing India-US trade negotiations and tariff-related tensions.

item.title: 'Modified' form 6 row: Why is Rahul Gandhi training his guns on Gyanesh Kumar, what SC said and how EC responded
item.description: Supreme Court clarifies it did not approve changes to Election Commission's Form 6 for voter registration. With allegations of unilateral decisions by CEC Gyanesh Kumar, the Congress party launches protests, questioning the integrity of the electoral process. The political drama intensifies.

item.title: White House Monitors Suspected Plague Case in Russia
item.description: The White House is monitoring reports of a suspected plague case in Russia’s Siberian region of Irkutsk, after the death of a worker at an anti-plague research institute led to almost 200 contacts reportedly being placed under observation.

item.title: Trump Says US Will Help Russia After Plague Death in Siberia
item.description: President Donald Trump said the US was looking into a suspected plague case in Russia following the death of a worker at a laboratory and would offer authorities there assistance.

item.title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Was Ben Gurion target? What Trump, Vance said on Iran link
item.description: The Flydubai cockpit attack has raised questions over whether Ben Gurion Airport was the intended target. Investigators have reportedly said that co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami planned the attack. US President Donald Trump has blamed Iran, while Vice President JD Vance said there is no conclusive link.

item.title: Israel and its Arab neighbours: How conflicts are reshaping on-again and off-again ties
item.description: Three years after the 7 October Hamas attack, Israel's relations with Arab countries remain deeply divided. While it maintains diplomatic ties with the UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Bahrain, the Gaza war and regional conflicts have strained old partnerships and complicated prospects for new ones.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 6: Check fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Oil prices edged down on Tuesday as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, though attacks by Yemen's Houthis on Saudi targets kept traders wary of risks to Gulf supplies.

item.title: Ahead of US midterms, Trump signs executive order to expand access to tax-exempt diesel: What we know
item.description: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order expanding access to tax-exempt diesel as record fuel prices pose a political risk ahead of the November midterm elections, which will determine control of Congress.

item.title: US-Iran war news LIVE: Oil prices decline as Middle East crude exports, G7 stockpile release ease supply concerns
item.description: US-Iran war news LIVE: Oil prices fell on Tuesday as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, though lingering security risks in the region capped further losses.

item.title: Abandoning pet in Chennai can cost ₹10,000, ₹5,000 for no licence; vet explains why microchipping is beneficial
item.description: Starting from 1 October, pet parents may be fined ₹10,000 if their cat or dog is found abandoned in Chennai. &nbsp;The Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) plans to track down owners of lost or abandoned pets by scanning their microchips, which is currently mandatory for all pets in the city.

item.title: Beyond assembly: how India’s next telecom PLI wants to build the supply chain from within
item.description: The existing telecom PLI scheme, launched in February 2021, incentivizes local production of network switches, transmission gear, and set-top boxes over a five-year period ending as late as FY27. However, the scheme has seen uneven adoption.

item.title: Caleb Flynn, ex-American Idol singer, sentenced to life without parole after being found guilty of wife Ashley’s murder
item.description: Former American Idol contestant and Ohio pastor Caleb Flynn has been sentenced to life without parole for murdering his wife, Ashley. Prosecutors said he staged a break-in after the February shooting and blamed an intruder.

item.title: Yemen Says It’s Retaken Mocha as Battle for Bab El-Mandeb Looms
item.description: Yemen’s armed forces wrested control of the Red Sea city of Mocha on Monday after battles with the Iran-backed Houthis, according to state-run Saba, which puts the internationally recognized government closer to taking over the vital Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: US DOJ moves to revoke citizenship of 40 naturalised Americans accused of hiding criminal pasts
item.description: The US Justice Department has filed denaturalisation cases against 40 naturalised citizens accused of concealing criminal records, immigration fraud or other material facts when seeking citizenship. The cases form the largest such filing period under the Trump administration.

item.title: Actor Robert Kelker-Kelley, known for ‘Days of Our Lives’, dies at 62
item.description: Days of Our Lives actor Robert Kelker-Kelly has died aged 62. The actor, best known for playing Bo Brady, died in Missouri on October 3, according to a medical examiner. His cause of death has not been disclosed.

item.title: Omani pilot used crash axe to stab Captain Smit Machchar during Flydubai flight —what is its purpose? Expert explains
item.description: A Flydubai co-pilot allegedly attacked Captain Smit Machchhar with a cockpit crash axe and attempted to take control of flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The aircraft later diverted to Saudi Arabia. What is the purpose of crash axe in cockpit? Aviation expert explains.

item.title: BA295 flight crisis nothing now: 5 British Airways emergencies from the past; crisis and survival stories
item.description: BA295 was not the first time British Airways encountered a crisis. The airline has experienced multiple emergencies in the past.

item.title: Delhi content creator, 23, reveals ₹1.12 lakh monthly income after quitting ₹60K job
item.description: The other five collaborations involved posts on her Instagram account and brought in a combined ₹97,000. Upasana, however, noted that some of the collaborations have not been published yet.

item.title: Delhi-based makeup artist's ₹4.5 lakh weekly earnings stun internet: ‘Thinking about burning off my 15 years of degrees’
item.description: According to Momina, she spent ‘countless days’ working on free collaborations to build her portfolio and demonstrate her skills.

item.title: Using AI too much? Doctor shares 5 warning signs to watch out for before it takes toll on your mental health
item.description: AI usage can become a concern when it starts replacing even minor things that one should be doing by themselves. A doctor explained how it may impact your mental well-being in the long run. Take a look.

item.title: Fire breaks out near Ranbir Kapoor’s Ramayana set in Mumbai, no injuries reported as safety concerns arise
item.description: A minor fire broke out in a tent outside Prime Focus Studios in Mumbai, where Ranbir Kapoor-starrer Ramayana is being shot. FWICE president BN Tiwari confirmed no one was injured and said shooting resumed.

item.title: Nigeria Air Force plane crashes en route to Lagos, killing all 32 on board- What we know
item.description: A Nigerian Air Force ATR-42 crashed in Ondo state while flying from Benin City to Lagos, killing all 32 people aboard. An investigation is underway.

item.title: Earthquake Today: Magnitude 4.9 earthquake strikes Afghanistan
item.description: An earthquake of magnitude 4.9 on the Richter scale jolted Afghanistan in the early hours of Monday, the National Centre for Seismology (NCS) said.

item.title: Karoline Leavitt joins Fox News after stepping down from Trump's administration: Here's what we know
item.description: Karoline Leavitt announced her exit from White House after welcoming her second child. She served as the press secretary.

item.title: BA295 flight status: London-Chicago British Airways’ aircraft plunges 27,000 feet in 7 minutes; here’s what happened
item.description: British Airways flight BA295 returned to Heathrow due to a cabin pressurization issue, descending rapidly from 36,000 to 9,000 feet. Concerns arose over its landing weight, exceeding the maximum by 30 tonnes, complicating fuel management before landing.

item.title: Who is Rahul Vohra? From a ₹144 crore LinkedIn exit to a health crisis that changed his work-life balance
item.description: Rahul Vohra is an Indo-British entrepreneur and the founder of productivity-focused email startup Superhuman.
